facts.fact: On 17 November 2026 the PAFEN project unit, for the ICT secretariat SETIC, issued an IDA-funded request for proposals (Lot 1) for a sovereign national public key infrastructure with root and issuing certification authorities, to serve all ministries, with bids due 11 January 2027.

BDI.note: A government data centre is named as an install site only; no data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: On 17 November 2026 PAFEN issued an IDA-funded request for proposals (Lot 2, 15 months) for a government interoperability platform on the X-Road model, saying institutions currently work largely in silos with limited standardised data exchange.

BDI.note: A national data governance strategy (SNGD) is named only as something the programme aligns with; no adoption or draft status stated.
Vision 2040-2060 and the public services digitalisation master plan are named, with no standing, text or period stated.
A public administration reference architecture (PAERA) is named only; no interoperability framework status stated.
No nationally owned data centre for hire stated.
